xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5236: Dashboard tabs keep running old frontend code after a deploy, silently: show a reload banner

plan.title: Dashboard tabs keep running old frontend code after a deploy, silently: show a reload banner
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After a deploy an open dashboard tab keeps running the frontend it loaded earlier and nothing says so. Verified fixes (PAN-5184) look like regressions. StaleBuildChip only compares the server build with origin/main; nothing compares the tab's bundle with the server.
narratives.Proposal: vite build compiles the checkout commit into the bundle (__OVERDECK_FRONTEND_BUILD_COMMIT__, null under vite serve). A new lib/buildDrift.ts fetches /api/health buildCommit once per /ws/rpc stream rising edge (connect and every reconnect, no polling) and a new NewBuildBanner shows 'A newer Overdeck is running. Reload to update.' with a Reload button when both commits are known and differ, noting that unsent drafts are kept (existing pagehide flush). Mounted in the app shell, the web /m shell and the conversation popout. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5236.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to /api/health, the server build, the contracts, the dashboard snapshot, or EventRouter.tsx
- No automatic reload of any kind; recovery.tsx chunk-failure reload is unchanged
- No banner in the native phone app (apps/mobile), the terminal popout, the diff popout or the Flywheel popout
- No dismiss button or snooze beyond the same-server-commit suppression after a tried reload
- No commit-ancestry check (a rollback reads the same text)
- No detection of a dirty rebuild of the same commit
- No change to StaleBuildChip or useDeployStaleness
- No new polling interval

autoDecisions.summary: Server commit comes from one GET /api/health per stream rising edge, not a snapshot field or new RPC
autoDecisions.rationale: /api/health already returns buildCommit; the cached snapshot is synced before bootstrap and would compare against the old server; no server/contract change and no polling.

autoDecisions.summary: Banner shows only when both commits are non-empty and differ; the Vite define is null under vite serve
autoDecisions.rationale: pan dev hot-rebuilds only the server, so dev tabs would always drift and Reload could not fix them; null means unknown, and unknown must not nag.

autoDecisions.summary: No automatic reload anywhere in this change
autoDecisions.rationale: Issue requirement 4 forbids auto-reload with drafts or dialogs open; never auto-reloading satisfies it with no dialog/draft detection logic.

autoDecisions.summary: Reload relies on the existing pagehide draft flush and states 'Unsent drafts are kept.' when a draft exists
autoDecisions.rationale: ComposerPromptEditor already flushes on pagehide (tested); the issue allows 'say so or flush'.

autoDecisions.summary: After a Reload that did not clear the mismatch for the same server commit, the banner stays hidden (sessionStorage key)
autoDecisions.rationale: A server-only rebuild cannot be fixed by reloading; repeating the banner would nag with no remedy.

autoDecisions.summary: Surfaces: app shell, web /m shell, conversation popout; not the native phone app or the terminal/diff/Flywheel popouts
autoDecisions.rationale: The conversation popout has a composer (the motivating bug); the native app bundle cannot be reloaded to update; the other popouts have no composer.

autoDecisions.summary: No dismiss button; amber warning tone matching DegradedModeBanner
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for a banner with a Reload button only; style guide maps amber to 'a human must act'.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In src/dashboard/frontend/vite.config.ts add and export async resolveFrontendBuildCommit(command: 'build'|'serve', readHead = git rev-parse HEAD at repo root via promisified execFile): returns null for 'serve', trimmed HEAD for 'build', null when readHead rejects or returns blank. Make the default export `defineConfig(async ({ command, mode }) => ({ ... define: { __OVERDECK_FRONTEND_BUILD_COMMIT__: JSON.stringify(await resolveFrontendBuildCommit(command)) }, ... }))`; nothing else in the config changes. Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/vite-build-commit.test.ts (import from '../vite.config' like src/vite-proxy-config.test.ts) with the four cases in PRD WI-1, and insert `src/vite-build-commit.test.ts` into scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position. Resolve the repo root with fileURLToPath(new URL('../../..', import.meta.url)), not import.meta.dirname; keep resolveProxy a plain named export.

Given command 'build' and readHead resolving 'abc123\n', resolveFrontendBuildCommit returns 'abc123'

Add lib/buildDrift.ts: bundle commit, drift rule, /api/health fetch on stream rising edge

expected_outputs: lint completes without errors (no new circular import)

narrative.Action: PRD WI-2. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/buildDrift.ts with exactly the exports named in PRD WI-2: bundleBuildCommit (module-level `declare const __OVERDECK_FRONTEND_BUILD_COMMIT__` read through a typeof guard, never vite-env.d.ts), isBuildDrift (true only for two different non-empty strings), BUILD_DRIFT_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS=3000, fetchServerBuildCommit (GET /api/health, cache 'no-store', AbortController+setTimeout timeout like probeServerHealth in lib/connectionState.ts; returns {ok:true, commit} or {ok:false}), the useBuildDrift zustand store {serverCommit, setServerCommit}, RELOADED_FOR_KEY='overdeck.build-drift.reloaded-for' with markReloadedFor/reloadAlreadyTriedFor (sessionStorage in try/catch), and startBuildDriftWatch(fetchImpl) that checks once if streamLive is already true and then on every streamLive false->true transition via useConnectionState.subscribe, dedupes in-flight checks, keeps the previous commit on {ok:false}, and returns an unsubscribe that also voids late results. connectionState.ts must not import buildDrift.ts. Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/__tests__/buildDrift.test.ts covering every case in PRD WI-2 with vi.useFakeTimers for the timeout, and insert `src/lib/__tests__/buildDrift.test.ts` into scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position. The in-flight and disposed flags are local to each startBuildDriftWatch call, never module-level.

items.title: isBuildDrift returns true for ('a','b') and false for ('a','a'), (null,'b'), ('a',null) and ('','b')
Given a fake fetch, startBuildDriftWatch calls GET /api/health with cache 'no-store' exactly once per streamLive false->true transition and never on a true->true update
Given a fetch that rejects or never settles, fetchServerBuildCommit returns {ok:false} (the hung case after 3000 ms of fake time) and the stored serverCommit keeps its previous value
Given the unsubscribe returned by startBuildDriftWatch has run, when streamLive rises from false to true again, then the fake fetch is never called and serverCommit is unchanged
reloadAlreadyTriedFor returns true after markReloadedFor with the same commit and returns false when sessionStorage.getItem throws
Add the NewBuildBanner component and hasSavedDraft helper

narrative.Action: PRD WI-3. Add hasSavedDraft() to src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/composerDraft.ts (true when any non-empty conv-draft:* localStorage key exists; try/catch -> false) and extend src/lib/__tests__/composerDraft.test.ts. Create src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/NewBuildBanner.tsx with props {bundleCommit?, reload?, fetchImpl?, safeAreaTop?} exactly as in PRD WI-3: starts startBuildDriftWatch in an effect, renders null unless isBuildDrift(bundle, serverCommit) && !reloadAlreadyTriedFor(serverCommit), otherwise a role=status row with data-component="new-build-banner", the text 'A newer Overdeck is running. Reload to update.', the extra sentence ' Unsent drafts are kept.' when hasSavedDraft(), and a Reload button whose handler calls markReloadedFor(serverCommit) then reload() (default window.location.reload()). Add src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/__tests__/NewBuildBanner.test.tsx with every case in PRD WI-3 and insert `src/components/__tests__/NewBuildBanner.test.tsx` into scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt in sorted position.
